name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Technology-neutral BRAM-style buffer interface for bounded command and response history. It provides the storage abstraction required for FPGA block RAM mapping without flattening bulk storage into registers.
functionality: Provides a synthesizable abstraction for bounded buffer storage to hold outstanding command and response words, sequence metadata, and status history. The implementation contract expects mapping to a native FPGA block RAM resource or equivalent vendor BRAM primitive. The buffer is finite and controlled; it shall not infer large register arrays for bulk payload storage.
responsibilities: Store bounded command/response entries in BRAM-friendly form.
Provide synchronous read/write access for controller-side buffering.
Avoid register-based flattening of history storage.
Support finite, parameterized queue depth only.
reset_behavior: On reset, read data returns deterministic inactive contents and no storage write is performed until explicitly enabled by the controller.
behavior_rules: Storage depth must remain finite and parameterized.
Implementation shall be compatible with FPGA BRAM inference or instantiation.
No unsynthesizable constructs or large register-file alternatives are permitted.
